remarks: Experience elevated living in this beautifully updated one-bedroom residence offering breathtaking unobstructed east-facing views and an abundance of natural light. The expansive open-concept layout features a spacious living and dining area with updated flooring and oversized windows that seamlessly connect to a private balcony overlooking a picturesque tree-lined landscape. The renovated galley kitchen is appointed with white shaker cabinetry, granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a stylish glass tile backsplash. A generously sized bedroom easily accommodates a king-size bed while offering ample space for a home office or sitting area, complemented by excellent closet storage. The refreshed bath adds to the home's move-in-ready appeal. Residents enjoy the convenience of a full-service building with 24-hour security, concierge, fitness center, community room, bike storage, private storage, guest parking, on-site superintendent, and beautifully maintained courtyard grilling areas. Heat, hot water, and central air are included, providing exceptional value and carefree living. Ideally located just moments from vibrant downtown Stamford, Metro-North, shopping, restaurants, parks, and major highways, this exceptional rental combines space, comfort, amenities, and one of the building's most desirable unobstructed exposures. A rare opportunity to enjoy easy luxury living in one of Stamford's premier condominium communities.
